Do you thrive in fast-paced, hands-on environments where you can get out on-site, create content, and grow a brand community from the ground up? If this sounds like you, a fast-growing, innovative chemical manufacturer within the trade and DIY space is looking for an Influencer & Community Marketing Executive to help take their brand presence to the next level.
